description: This file manages the loose object index mapping in a Git repository, including loading, saving, inserting, and clearing the index of loose objects and their compatibility mappings.

classes.name: struct loose_object_map
classes.description: Structure that maintains mappings between object IDs and their compatibility equivalents.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_init(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Initializes a loose_object_map structure by allocating memory and initializing hash tables.

methods.name: int insert_oid_pair(kh_oid_map_t * map,const struct object_id * key,const struct object_id * value)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into a hash map, allocating memory for the stored object ID.

methods.name: int insert_loose_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Inserts a pair of object IDs into the loose object map and updates the cache.

methods.name: int load_one_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo,struct odb_source * source)
methods.description: Loads a loose object map from disk, parsing the index file and populating the map and cache.

methods.name: int repo_read_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Reads the loose object map for all sources in a repository.

methods.name: int repo_write_loose_object_map(struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map to disk.

methods.name: int write_one_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Writes a single object mapping to the index file.

methods.name: int repo_add_loose_object_map(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,const struct object_id * compat_oid)
methods.description: Adds a new object ID pair to the loose object map and updates disk.

methods.name: int repo_loose_object_map_oid(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Retrieves the local object ID corresponding to a source object ID from the map.

methods.name: void loose_object_map_clear(struct loose_object_map ** map)
methods.description: Clears and frees memory associated with a loose_object_map.
